liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **C C Rider** (1 review): Matt Kelly's performance brought the band back to their blues roots [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-12-31.sbd.miller.77301.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 190 min; rated 3.58/5 by 12 [1]
- **gd1982-12-31.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.105820.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 165 min [2]
- **gd1982-12-31.148505.mat.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 164 min [3]
- **gd82-12-31.sbd.bode.5958.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 152 min; rated 4.16/5 by 19 [8]. Said about its sound: Garcia's guitar is often lost in the mix of this recording; Garcia's solo and Cipollina's whammy-bar effects are less prominent than older fragments [15][16]
- **gd1982-12-31.134487.s3.nak300.schley.flac2448**: audience recording; 6 songs; 36 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [11]

## Around the show

- Etta James remarked the audience was a bunch of crazies grooving intensely [18]
- Etta James barely recognized the band, later praising the guitarist's skills [19]
- Bobby exclaimed about the balloons visible at the end of the first verse [20]
- The reviewer waited hours to retrieve a jacket, then crawled into foggy Haight [21]
- Weird sound effects at the start of the song marked the New Year's countdown [23]
- The show did not live up to the previous New Year's Eve performance [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-12-31.sbd.miller.77301.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Cassettes provided by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90) [1]
- **gd1982-12-31.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.105820.flac16**: taped by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90) [2]. Also: Etta James and Tower of Power Horns performed the third set [2]
- **gd1982-12-31.148505.mat.tobin.flac16**: transferred by SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [3]. Also: Stephen Doc Kupka played baritone saxophone, mixed by an archive.org user [3]
- **gd82-12-31.sbd.bode.5958.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Keith Bode; source: Soundboard [8]
- **gd1982-12-31.134487.s3.nak300.schley.flac2448**: taped by Brian Schley; transferred by Andrew F.; source: 3rd Set AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5 > Hitachi ME Metal tape. Set up FOB, recording by Brian Schley. [11]. Also: Jon Pasternak and Charlie McGuth organized the project; other tapes are currently lost [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Gregg Nixon Grateful Dead: [1982-12-31 Oakland Auditorium Arena, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-12-31-oakland-auditorium-arena-oakland-ca-usa/) [27]
